title: Canonical shift structures of scalar support functors
statement: Equip the exact tensor, restriction, open-extension, reduction and separately right-derived proper-image and limit functors of [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate] and [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps] with their canonical integer shifts. Define OriginalMateShift(a,c) as the conjunction of CommShift for the actual proper comparison, open comparison, inverse scalar/pullback comparison, and geometric adjunction counit. These are precisely the constructions formerly at the beginning of lem-pur-compact-support-scalar-shift-normalization; no comparison map or shift structure is changed. The functors and maps are those of [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].
